name: HY-Motion: Stop fleeing, stand facing B. Execute a rapid backbend to extremely dodge backward (Matrix style slow-motion dodge), falling toward the ground. During the descent, the left arm stretches out wide to the side to maintain dynamic equilibrium. Upon hitting the ground, the left hand and arm slam flat against the floor to absorb the impact and provide stable leverage, anchoring the body while the right arm raises the pistol to fire diagonally upward at about 35 degrees forward.
